# The RiskMandate roadmap: policies, understand, contain, manage, accelerate, then insurance, and a foundationhometo governfor the Agent Behaviour Policy outside RiskMandate

Summary: This is a proposed roadmap for RiskMandate, and two decisions. The first is about governance. On 8 October RiskMandate's two founders decided to propose the Agent Behaviour Policy to OWASP as an open project, because a description of what an agent can do should not belong to the company that sells it. It was not the right fit for an OWASP hasproject,saidsono.theSo wepolicy will setmoveupto the Open Security Summit instead, as a foundationhostedfor it instead:project: the point is the same, that the policy is governed outside the RiskMandate organisation, which today is mostly The Cyber Boardroom. The second is the roadmap: five stages of development, then insurance. Policies, then understand, then contain, then manage, then accelerate, and then insurance. We are in the first stage: creating the policies and the flows, with our first customers, whose programme is now running at customers.riskmandate.ai. The later stages we will start as they are needed, as we get more customers and users and the offering matures. This is the plan; the stages after the first are a first reading, to be refined with the people using it.
